verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Firebase's core realtime sync/listener mechanism (Firestore listeners, offline sync) and community anecdotes describing building 'real time' collaborative apps and 'real time notifications', which implies infrastructure capable of broadcasting live state between clients. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents a presence system (e.g., onDisconnect handlers, .info/connected) or ephemeral/transient state broadcast semantics. Missing for 10: explicit docs on presence detection (onDisconnect, connection state), and any independent confirmation of ephemeral state broadcasting patterns.
